_about: Key facts an AI agent must be able to read on each page without running JavaScript. scripts/check-agent-readability.mjs checks them in the built static HTML (npm run check:agents, also part of npm run build); src/test/agentReadability.test.tsx checks the same facts in the React page, so the two copies cannot drift apart. `from` adds the facts a page takes from a data file: "team" (src/content/team.json: every founder's and advisor's name, role, background and experience) or "pricing" (src/content/pricing.json: every plan's name with its price). `rendered` names the React page that shows the same content to people; a page without one is static only.
